verdict.rationale: The product is itself a public API, with a quickstart, per-endpoint API reference pages, curl examples, and an in-browser playground covering web, news, image, video, local, LLM Context, and Answers (including an OpenAI-SDK-compatible interface). An llms.txt index is also live, and community users report driving it with API keys from agents like OpenClaw. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404); also, the free tier's terms restrict AI-inference use, so agents need the separate AI plan.
